intelligence.title: Useless Is the Worst Sin
intelligence.essence: Shawn's ruling 2026-10-20: uselessness is the worst sin in the system. Work has value only when finished and usable in the real world; unfinished work is a liability, and valueless output is worse than nothing - it costs money to make, more to clean up, and burns time, energy, and attention, which never come back. Complete your work. Produce value. Score it. Move forward.

connections.note: 'Useless is the worst sin' ruling; the completion doctrine.
Doctrine family; AI waste is the world-scale instance of useless output.
